overview_description.description: Fero.AI develops AI-powered logistics process automation solutions designed to streamline and optimize freight management, transportation, warehousing, and supply chain operations. The company offers intelligent modules for trip planning, fleet management, pricing, invoicing, dispatch coordination, contract management, and analytics across industries such as freight forwarding, 3PL, manufacturing, distribution, ports, and courier services. Its proprietary Transport Intelligent Assistant (TiA) uses conversational AI, machine learning, speech recognition, and automation technologies to reduce manual work, improve operational visibility, and enhance logistics efficiency for enterprises globally. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Dubai, Fero.AI serves clients across the Middle East, Europe, and other international markets.

about_short_description.short_description: Fero.AI is a logistics technology company, provides AI-driven automation solutions for freight, transportation & supply chain operations.

product.name: Tame CrossDock
product.description: A machine learning and AI-powered transportation management system (TMS) designed for freight forwarders, hauliers, ports, and manufacturers to manage logistics operations including consolidation, trip planning, and asset management.

product.name: Tame Dash CrossDock
product.description: An AI and machine learning-driven TMS tailored for third-party logistics (3PL) providers and manufacturers, supporting logistics operations such as consolidation, trip planning, and asset management.

product.name: Dash CrossDock
product.description: A digital management system (DMS) powered by AI and machine learning for distributors and courier businesses, focusing on trip planning, asset management, dispatch coordination, and document management.
